extDescription.message: Tints the LibreWolf interface with the colour of the current website and adds a button to hide the tab row.

commandToggle.message: Hide or show the tab row

menuAutoHide.message: Hide tabs when there is only one

optGlassHint.message: Translucent toolbars that show a blurred view of what is behind the window.

optNeutralHint.message: For the new tab page, settings, add-ons, PDFs and sites without their own background.

optNeutralDefault.message: Default: white in light mode and grey in dark mode.

optAutoHideTitle.message: Hide the tab row when there is only one tab

optAutoHideHint.message: The tabs button can still show it.

optToggleHint.message: Also with the toolbar button; right-click it for more options.

optNote.message: Glass needs huewolf-glass.css active and “Transparency effects” turned on in Windows.
